coverage.note: Chunks 40-44 carry the lunar-language invocation and its translation; they belong to the language layer of phase 8 and are kept as reference text, not as a separate phase.

exercises.name: Shared visualization drill
exercises.practice: Hold one concrete image of the deity's form for a fixed count of breaths, then compare descriptions with the group.

exercises.name: Alternating chant coordination
exercises.practice: Two voices exchange short phrases without breaking rhythm; increase duration across sessions.

exercises.name: Cue recognition
exercises.practice: Stop the chant exactly on the officiant's signal; repeat until the transition is clean.

exercises.name: Intention declaration
exercises.practice: Write the intention in one sentence, speak it aloud, and judge every later step against it.

exercises.name: Aspect study
exercises.practice: List the deity's aspects and histories from the source before any working; note agreements and tensions.

gaps: The source defines no durations for any phase.
